title: Zanzibar's Sandbanks: Nakupenda, Mange and More
excerpt: Zanzibar has several sandbanks that appear at low tide: white sand surrounded by turquoise water. Which ones to visit and how.
body:
Sandbanks are strips of white sand in the sea that appear at low tide and shrink or disappear at high tide. On Zanzibar, they make for a beautiful half-day trip.

## Nakupenda

Nakupenda ("I love you" in Swahili) lies off Stone Town. A short boat ride takes you there for swimming, snorkelling and often a seafood lunch.

## Mange and others

Other sandbanks, such as Mange, lie in Menai Bay or off the coast. Some are visited on [Safari Blue](/blog/safari-blue-zanzibar/) day trips.

## Tips

- Check the tide; trips are planned around low tide.
- There is no shade, so bring sun protection.
- Take all rubbish back with you.

## Combine

With Stone Town, [Prison Island](/blog/zanzibar-travel-guide/) or a [sunset dhow cruise](/blog/sunset-dhow-cruise/).

[Plan your Zanzibar excursions](/travel-proposal/).
